purpose: Seventh expanded public source layer focused on organosilicon/boron/phosphorus medicinal motifs, fluorinated lipophiles and macrocycle-relevant fluoro motifs, halogenated marine terpenoids, sugar-nucleotide and glycoconjugate vaccine boundaries, cofactor-mimic redox-active scaffolds, non-ADC covalent bioconjugation, biomimetic natural-product dimerization, and process impurity/metabolite route critique.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
separate element-specific, isotope/electronic, halogenation, glycan, redox, bioconjugation, dimerization, impurity, or metabolite policy
route-specific stability, stereochemistry, label or heteroatom placement, conjugation site, oxidation state, oligomer topology, and impurity-control review

metalloid toxicity, fluorinated-lipophile exposure, marine bioactive halometabolite, vaccine/glycan manufacturing, redox-cycling, bioconjugation, genotoxic-impurity, nitrosamine, or process-control review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
impurity, redox-active, halogenated marine, bioconjugate, vaccine, and metalloid entries are high-level route priors only

families.name: Organosilicon, boron, phosphorus, and metalloid medicinal motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate carbon-to-silicon or metalloid isostere decisions, boron/phosphorus binding modes, and element-specific stability or toxicity from ordinary carbon scaffold synthesis.

families.name: Fluorinated macrocycle-relevant motifs and trifluoromethyl lipophiles
families.strategic_principle: Treat fluorine placement as route-defining when it controls conformation, metabolism, pKa, polarity, or lipophilicity. Late-stage fluorination and fluoroalkyl fragment choice are separate strategic boundaries.

families.name: Halogenated marine terpenoids and halometabolite natural products
families.strategic_principle: Separate terpene or polyketide skeleton assembly from halogen placement, biosynthetic halogenase logic, and marine bioactivity/toxicity context. Halogenated marine motifs are not generic aryl/alkyl halide decorations.

families.name: Sugar-nucleotide donors, bacterial glycans, and glycoconjugate vaccine linkers
families.strategic_principle: Separate antigenic glycan assembly, sugar-nucleotide donor or chemoenzymatic module, linker/handle installation, and carrier conjugation. Immunogenic epitope identity is strategic metadata.

families.name: Cofactor mimics and redox-active medicinal scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Separate scaffold synthesis from redox state, electron-transfer function, nuisance/reactivity liability, and biological target context. Oxidation-state cycling is route-defining metadata.

families.name: Non-ADC covalent bioconjugation and payload attachment motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate payload synthesis, biomolecule conjugation site, linker chemistry, and bioorthogonal handle compatibility. Conjugation chemistry is strategic only with site, stoichiometry, stability, and biological function metadata.

families.name: Natural-product dimers, oligomers, and biomimetic oxidative coupling
families.strategic_principle: Expose monomer units, coupling topology, oxidation state, regioselectivity, and atropisomer/stereochemical outcome. Dimerization is a route-defining step, not an ordinary late substituent merge.

families.name: Process impurities, degradants, metabolites, and route-control critique
families.strategic_principle: Separate target route synthesis from impurity formation, degradation pathways, metabolite/reference-standard synthesis, and control strategy. Impurity records are route-critique and risk-control sources, not target stock shortcuts.

anchors.name: Element-specific medicinal isostere or binding motif
Fluorinated motif with conformation, pKa, metabolism, or lipophilicity role
Marine terpene or halometabolite skeleton with reviewed halogenation policy
Antigenic glycan, linker handle, sugar donor module, and carrier conjugation boundary
Cofactor-like or redox-active scaffold with oxidation-state and electron-transfer metadata
Payload, biomolecule site, bioorthogonal handle, and linker chemistry
Monomeric natural-product units and biomimetic coupling topology
Impurity, degradant, or metabolite formation and control boundary

disconnections.name: Silicon-switch analogue to parent carbon scaffold plus sila-substitution policy

target_features: altered lipophilicity, geometry, or metabolic stability

break_bonds: C-Si bond or silacycle boundary traced to parent carbon scaffold and silicon building block
forward_logic: identify the parent carbon scaffold and the intended silicon-switch position
track geometry, lipophilicity, metabolic stability, and silicon-specific liability
separate silicon motif installation from ordinary alkyl/aryl substitution
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that explain why silicon replacement is strategic and preserve parent-scaffold mapping.

risks: toxicity and off-target profile may differ from carbon analogue

evidence.citation: Organosilicon medicinal chemistry review discusses silicon in drug discovery and silicon-switch concepts.
Metalloid antimicrobial review discusses medicinal potential and toxicity considerations for metalloids.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit parent-scaffold mapping and silicon-specific property rationale

disconnections.name: Boron/phosphorus medicinal motif to binding/prodrug handle plus parent scaffold

break_bonds: C-B or C-P medicinal motif boundary
forward_logic: separate parent binding scaffold from boron/phosphorus functional motif
track covalent/reversible binding, pKa, hydrolysis, prodrug activation, and toxicity
avoid treating boronate/phosphonate as a generic acid bioisostere without mechanism metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use boron/phosphorus entries only when binding mode or prodrug role is explicit.

evidence.citation: Boron in medicine review summarizes delivery, detection, and medicinal boron context.
Phosphonate therapeutics review covers natural and synthetic phosphonate drugs.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit binding/prodrug mechanism and stability metadata

disconnections.name: Fluorinated lipophile to parent scaffold plus CF3/difluoroalkyl late-stage policy

target_features: CF3, CHF2, fluoroalkyl, or perfluoroalkyl group
late-stage fluorination or fluoroalkyl fragment installation

forward_logic: define whether the fluorinated motif is installed early as a building block or late onto the parent scaffold
track pKa, lipophilicity, metabolism, and exposure changes
separate fluorine source policy from ordinary alkyl substituent logic
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit fluorine-placement rationale and late-stage versus fragment-based policy.

evidence.citation: Review of fluorine-containing approved drugs summarizes significance and synthetic insights for fluorinated medicines.
Fluorinated terpenoid review illustrates fluorinated derivative design in lipophilic natural-product-like scaffolds.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit fluorination timing and metabolic/lipophilic role

disconnections.name: C-F conformational lock or fluoroalkene motif to parent geometry policy

forward_logic: map the parent conformation or bioisostere being mimicked
separate fluorinated building-block preparation from macrocycle or constrained scaffold closure
track stereoelectronic and conformational evidence before route scoring
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Do not score C-F motifs as decoration when conformation or bioisosterism is the strategic reason.

evidence.citation: C-F conformational tool review discusses exploiting fluorine as a small-molecule folding element.
Fluorinated heterocycle review summarizes therapeutic uses of fluorinated motifs in medicinal scaffolds.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only with conformational or bioisostere metadata

disconnections.name: Halogenated marine terpenoid to terpene core plus halogenation policy

break_bonds: C-Br or C-Cl bond traced to halogenation stage
forward_logic: separate terpene skeleton assembly from halogenation timing and site policy
track whether halogen placement is biosynthetic, biomimetic, or late-stage chemical
keep marine bioactive or toxin-like targets advisory until reviewed
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose halogen-placement policy rather than treating bromine/chlorine as generic leaving groups.

evidence.citation: Marine-derived diterpene review covers structures, biological activities, synthesis, and applications.
Halogenase review describes opportunities for synthetic biology and C-H functionalization.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit terpene core and halogen-placement metadata

disconnections.name: Marine halometabolite to core scaffold plus halogenated bioactivity/toxicity critique

break_bonds: late halogenation or dehalogenated precursor boundary
forward_logic: separate dehalogenated core route from halogenated analogue policy
track whether halogen substitution controls activity, toxicity, or recognition
avoid unreviewed promotion for potent marine bioactive halometabolites
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use as critique source for halogen-dependent marine bioactivity, not as automatic stock/proposal closure.

evidence.citation: Marine-derived fungal halometabolite review summarizes pharmacological activity of halogenated metabolites.
Marine actinobacterial halometabolite review covers bioactivities and source context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: low unless bioactivity/toxicity and halogen role are explicit

disconnections.name: Glycoconjugate vaccine to antigenic glycan, linker handle, and carrier boundary

forward_logic: define antigenic glycan epitope and reducing-end or handle placement
separate glycan synthesis from linker installation and carrier conjugation
track immunogenicity, loading, epitope preservation, and analytical characterization
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit glycan/linker/carrier separation and epitope-preservation metadata.

evidence.citation: Chemoenzymatic glycan synthesis review discusses homogeneous glycans for bacterial glycoconjugate vaccine development.
Semisynthetic Hib glycoconjugate vaccine study illustrates defined glycan and carrier-conjugation development.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for glycan epitope, linker, and carrier metadata

disconnections.name: Bacterial glycan to sugar-nucleotide donor and glycosyltransferase module policy

break_bonds: glycosidic linkage traced to sugar-nucleotide donor/acceptor pair
forward_logic: separate monosaccharide donor synthesis or enzymatic generation from glycan assembly
track donor identity, linkage stereochemistry, and enzyme scope
connect donor policy to vaccine epitope identity only after review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use sugar-nucleotide records when donor identity and glycosyltransferase scope are explicit.

evidence.citation: RmlABCD enzyme study covers efficient synthesis of dTDP-L-rhamnose, a bacterial sugar-nucleotide donor.
Engineered E. coli carbohydrate-antigen production study illustrates heterologous bacterial glycan production.

disconnections.name: Cofactor mimic to recognition scaffold plus redox/electron-transfer function

forward_logic: separate cofactor-recognition scaffold from redox-active group and probe handle
track oxidation state, electron-transfer function, and enzyme scope
avoid scoring cofactor mimics as ordinary heteroaryl analogues
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit redox function and enzyme-recognition metadata for cofactor mimics.

evidence.citation: Functionalized cofactor mimic review covers cofactor mimics for interactome discovery.
Complex I review discusses artificial electron acceptors, inhibitors, and medicine-relevant electron transfer.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for cofactor-recognition and redox-function metadata

disconnections.name: Quinone/phenazine scaffold to redox-state and cycling-liability policy

target_features: quinone, hydroquinone, anthraquinone, or phenazine core
oxidative stress or complex-I-like target context

forward_logic: separate core scaffold synthesis from oxidation-state setting and redox-liability review
track whether redox activity is desired mechanism, toxicity, or assay interference
avoid treating quinone/phenazine motifs as ordinary aromatic cores
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Score redox-active scaffolds only with oxidation-state and reactivity-liability metadata.

evidence.citation: Anthraquinone scaffold review discusses translational barriers and redox-active quinone context.
Bacterial pigment review discusses phenazine-like pigment chemistry and biological applications.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only with oxidation-state and redox-liability metadata

disconnections.name: Bioconjugate to payload, linker, and biomolecule site-selective handle

forward_logic: separate payload synthesis from biomolecule modification and linker/handle selection
track conjugation site, stoichiometry, stability, and biological mode
do not score payload synthesis alone as completion of a bioconjugate route
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit payload/linker/site separation with conjugation stability metadata.

evidence.citation: Bioorthogonal ligation review summarizes modern bioconjugation reactions and strategies.
Antibody-oligonucleotide conjugate SAR study discusses effects of bioconjugation strategies.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for payload/linker/site and stability metadata

disconnections.name: Peptide/protein conjugate to ligation or dynamic thiol bioconjugation policy

target_features: native chemical ligation or related peptide/protein ligation

break_bonds: dynamic thiol or reversible linker boundary
forward_logic: define whether the conjugate is made by ligation, thiol exchange, or site-specific residue modification
track peptide/protein integrity, reversibility, and site selectivity
separate biomolecule engineering from small-molecule handle synthesis
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use ligation/thiol records only when site and reversibility metadata are explicit.

risks: protein denaturation or loss of activity

evidence.citation: Site-specific peptide/protein modification review covers modern residue-selective conjugation methods.
Dynamic thiol bioconjugation review covers tunable linkers for thiol-based strategies.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for site-specificity and reversibility metadata

disconnections.name: Natural-product dimer to monomer units plus biomimetic C-C/C-O coupling policy

target_classes: biaryl or diaryl ether natural products
target_features: C-C or C-O oxidative coupling linkage

break_bonds: intermonomer C-C or C-O coupling bond
forward_logic: identify monomeric units and coupling positions
define biomimetic oxidative coupling, metal-mediated coupling, or stepwise fragment-union policy
track regioselectivity, oxidation state, and axial/stereochemical outcome
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose monomer and coupling topology rather than treating dimers as one-piece scaffolds.

evidence.citation: Complanadine A synthesis comparison discusses strategic choices for alkaloid dimer total syntheses.
Bioinspired total synthesis review discusses biomimetic strategies for natural-product construction.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for monomer/coupling topology and stereochemical metadata

disconnections.name: Phenolic/biaryl oligomer to oxidative coupling and oligomer-control policy

break_bonds: biaryl or diaryl ether dimerization bond
forward_logic: separate monomer synthesis from oxidative coupling reagent/catalyst policy
track dimer versus oligomer distribution and atropisomerism
avoid promoting routes that ignore overcoupling or redox side products
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Require dimer/oligomer control and oxidative-coupling topology for phenolic natural products.

evidence.citation: DDQ-mediated C-C bond-formation review covers redox strategies for oxidative coupling.
Phenol/aryl-boronic acid homocoupling review illustrates biaryl synthesis and coupling control.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for oligomer-control and coupling-topology metadata

disconnections.name: Mutagenic or nitrosamine impurity to formation route and control-strategy policy

target_features: impurity formed by route reagent, intermediate, degradation, or storage condition
control strategy rather than target synthesis

break_bonds: impurity formation boundary traced to precursor/reagent/degradation source
forward_logic: identify whether the impurity arises from reagent, intermediate, API degradation, or packaging/storage
separate reference-standard synthesis from target route and control strategy
track toxicology class, analytical method, and purge/control point
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use impurity records for route critique and control, never as stock or target-route success.

evidence.citation: Mutagenic impurity guideline review discusses assessment and control of pharmaceutical mutagenic impurities.
NDSRI study covers nitrosamine drug-substance-related impurities under artificial gastric conditions.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for identifying impurity origin and control point in route audit

disconnections.name: Degradant or metabolite reference standard to API/precursor plus transformation-origin policy

target_features: oxidation, hydrolysis, rearrangement, or conjugation product of API
reference standard route distinct from API synthesis

forward_logic: map degradant/metabolite to API or process precursor and transformation origin
separate deliberate reference-standard synthesis from impurity formation in manufacturing
track analytical assignment, stability, and toxicity metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use degradant/metabolite records to explain route risks and standards, not to close target routes.

evidence.citation: Resmetirom related-substances study identifies new degradation products and analytical strategy.
Perampanel degradation-product study combines stability-indicating analysis and toxicity assessment.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for API-origin mapping and analytical/toxicology metadata

source_notes.summary: The v8 expansion promotes the next backlog families for metalloid medicinal motifs, fluorinated lipophiles, halogenated marine natural products, glycoconjugate vaccine boundaries, cofactor-mimic redox scaffolds, non-ADC bioconjugation, biomimetic dimer/oligomer coupling, and impurity/metabolite route critique.

Metalloid, fluorinated-lipophile, marine halometabolite, vaccine/glycan, redox-active, bioconjugation, natural-product dimer, and impurity/metabolite records are advisory. Promotion to proposal generation requires explicit toxicology, regulatory, formulation, biological-mode, manufacturing, or process-control review as applicable.
